title: Remove Duplicates from an Array
description: Use a Set to keep only one copy of each value while preserving insertion order.
commonMistake: Using indexOf in a loop is slower and easy to get wrong when values repeat.

title: Format a Date String
description: Turn a raw date object into a friendly display string using locale-aware formatting.
commonMistake: Forgetting that a date object is in UTC unless you convert it for the user's timezone.

title: Guard Optional Object Data
description: Read nested values safely when the response can be missing fields at any depth.
commonMistake: Calling user.profile.name without checking whether profile exists will throw at runtime.

title: Filter Active Users
description: Keep only the records that match a certain condition without mutating the original list.
commonMistake: Using splice inside a loop changes the array while you are iterating and can skip items.

title: Debounce an Input Handler
description: Delay a search callback briefly so it does not fire excessively while the user types.
commonMistake: Forgetting to clear the previous timer, which causes the callback to run too many times.

title: Build a Table Row from Data
description: Create DOM rows from an array of objects and attach them to the page without mixing markup and logic.
commonMistake: Using innerHTML with untrusted user input can allow script injection in the page.

title: Sum Cart Totals
description: Reduce a price list to one total value, starting from zero for a clean accumulator.
commonMistake: Omitting the initial value makes the first item behave like the accumulator and can produce the wrong result.

title: Parse a Query String
description: Turn a URL query string into a plain object so you can read values quickly.
commonMistake: Assuming query parameters are already decoded as a plain object without parsing them.

title: Run Async Tasks in Parallel
description: Resolve several small async helpers together and continue only when each task finishes.
commonMistake: Not handling a rejected promise means one failed task can break the whole batch.

title: Toggle a Modal Panel
description: Show and hide a modal using a boolean state and a small class toggle on the element.
commonMistake: Changing the hidden class without updating the state can make the UI look out of sync.

title: Remove Duplicates from a List
description: Use a first-seen-order approach to keep only the unique values while preserving their original order.
code:
values = [3, 1, 3, 2, 1]
unique = list(dict.fromkeys(values))
print(unique)  # [3, 1, 2]
commonMistake: Using a set directly throws away the original order of first appearance.

title: Title-Case a Name
description: Clean up a user name by trimming whitespace and converting it to title case.
code:
name = '  ava smith  '
clean_name = name.strip().title()
print(clean_name)  # Ava Smith
commonMistake: Calling title() before strip() leaves leading or trailing spaces in the output.

title: Read a CSV File
description: Load CSV data row by row and convert each line into a useful list of values.
code:
import csv
with open('students.csv', newline='') as file:
    reader = csv.reader(file)
    header = next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        print(dict(zip(header, row)))
commonMistake: Forgetting newline='' can produce blank lines when reading CSV data on Windows.

title: Filter Even Numbers
description: Select only the entries that satisfy a simple condition from a list of integers.
code:
numbers = [4, 7, 8, 11, 16]

def is_even(number):
    # Zero remainder means the value is divisible by two.
    return number % 2 == 0

# Keep values in their original order.
even_numbers = [number for number in numbers if is_even(number)]
print(even_numbers)  # [4, 8, 16]
assert all(number % 2 == 0 for number in even_numbers)
commonMistake: Using n / 2 == 0 does not test whether a number is even. Use n % 2 == 0 to check for a zero remainder.

title: Write JSON to Disk
description: Persist a dictionary as JSON so the data stays readable and can be reused later.
code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

settings = {'theme': 'dark', 'font': 14}
output_path = Path('settings.json')

# Write indented JSON directly to the file.
with output_path.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as file:
    json.dump(settings, file, indent=2)

saved_settings = json.loads(output_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print(saved_settings['theme'])  # dark
commonMistake: json.dumps returns a JSON string but does not write it to the open file; use json.dump(value, file) for direct file output.

title: Build a Student Record Class
description: Model a student with a constructor and a method that returns a readable summary.
commonMistake: Using mutable default arguments like [] makes each instance share the same state unless you initialize values inside __init__().

title: Safely Read a Nested Value
description: Use a function that returns a default when a nested dictionary key does not exist.
commonMistake: Calling user['profile']['city'] directly crashes if profile is missing.

title: Count Words in a File
description: Open a text file and count the number of words while handling encoding correctly.
code:
from collections import Counter
with open('notes.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as file:
    words = file.read().split()
counts = Counter(words)
print(counts.most_common(3))
commonMistake: Using file.read() without splitting whitespace will count whole paragraphs instead of individual words.

title: Merge Two Dictionaries
description: Combine configuration values from two dictionaries without overwriting information unexpectedly.
commonMistake: Using defaults.update(custom) mutates the original dictionary in place, which can surprise later code that still expects the original values.

title: List Files in a Directory
description: Scan a directory and print files that are ready to process with minimal extra logic.
commonMistake: Forgetting to check path.is_file() means folders are treated like files and can cause errors when you try to read them.

title: Parse a CSV Line
description: Split a comma-separated line into components and read each field safely.
commonMistake: Using a single comma split on a line with quoted values can break the data into the wrong fields.

title: Remove Duplicate Names
description: Use a set to retain only unique names and drop repeated entries from a list.
commonMistake: A HashSet removes duplicates but does not promise insertion-order iteration; use LinkedHashSet when the original order matters.

title: Create a Student Record
description: Model a student with fields and a method that returns a description string.
commonMistake: Making fields mutable without a need creates state that is harder to reason about.

title: Handle Missing Input
description: Wrap parsing logic in a try-catch block so missing or invalid input does not crash the program.
commonMistake: Catching the generic Exception type hides the real cause and makes debugging harder.

title: Sort Product Prices
description: Arrange price values in ascending order so the cheapest item appears first.
commonMistake: Collections.sort mutates the supplied list and returns void. Sort a copy when the original order must be preserved.

title: Filter a List with Streams
description: Use Java streams to keep only the names that match a simple condition.
commonMistake: Forgetting the terminal operation means no filtering actually happens, because streams are lazy until they are collected.

title: Format a Message with Dates
description: Create a readable message from a date object and a user's full name.
commonMistake: Using the default toString output can produce a less user-friendly format than the one your app needs.

title: Read a File with Try-With-Resources
description: Open a file in a controlled block so the stream closes automatically after use.
commonMistake: Leaving a file stream open can leak resources and make later reads fail unexpectedly.

title: Build a Bank Account Class
description: Define a class with fields and methods that model a simple balance update workflow.
commonMistake: Exposing mutable fields directly allows outside code to change the state without validation.

title: Return an Optional Value
description: Wrap a value in an Optional so callers can handle emptiness explicitly.
commonMistake: Calling Optional.get() without checking presence throws when it is empty; use orElse or another explicit empty-value path.

title: INNER JOIN Two Tables
description: Combine matching records from two tables using the shared key that connects them.
code:
SELECT s.student_id, s.name, c.course_name
FROM students s
INNER JOIN courses c
  ON s.course_id = c.id;
commonMistake: Using a cartesian product by forgetting the ON clause makes the result too large and hard to read.

title: Filter Active Customers
description: Return only the rows that match the current status value in the customer table.
code:
-- Assumes is_active is stored as a 1/0 flag.
SELECT customer_id,
       customer_name,
       is_active,
       created_at
FROM customers
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

-- Confirm the column type and flag convention in your schema.
commonMistake: The equality predicate assumes the schema stores active status as 1. Confirm the column type and stored flag values before relying on it.

title: Count Orders by Status
description: Group rows by their order status and count how many transactions fall into each bucket.
code:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY order_count DESC;
commonMistake: Putting the aggregate in the WHERE clause means the database never reaches the grouping step.

title: Update Stock Quantities
description: Adjust the stock count for a single product while keeping the change limited to the intended row.
code:
UPDATE inventory
SET quantity = quantity - 5
WHERE product_id = 42
  AND quantity >= 5;
commonMistake: Running the update without a WHERE clause changes every product in the table.

title: Find Top-Selling Products
description: Count the total units sold for each product and return only the best-performing rows.
code:
SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold
FROM order_items
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
commonMistake: Without GROUP BY product_id, the aggregate collapses everything into one row instead of showing each product separately.

title: LEFT JOIN Missing Records
description: Keep all rows from the left table even when there is no matching record on the right side.
code:
SELECT c.name, o.order_id
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id;
commonMistake: Using INNER JOIN removes customers with no orders and hides inactive or new accounts.

title: Filter a Date Range
description: Restrict results to records created between two dates, while being aware that timestamp values can include time-of-day data on the last day.
commonMistake: BETWEEN is inclusive at both ends, but timestamp values can still exclude the later part of the last day if the column stores time-of-day details.

title: Insert a New Student
description: Add a new student record with all required values in a single insert statement.
code:
INSERT INTO students (name, email, course_id)
VALUES ('Mila', 'mila@example.com', 7);
commonMistake: Forgetting a column list can break when the table adds a new field later.

title: Group Students by Department
description: Summarize the number of students attached to each department in the university dataset.
commonMistake: Without GROUP BY department_id, COUNT(*) collapses every department into a single aggregate row.

title: Delete Old Audit Logs
description: Preview and remove SQL Server audit rows older than a defined retention cutoff using T-SQL date functions.
commonMistake: This T-SQL statement is scoped to rows older than the cutoff, but preview the same predicate first and verify the retention period and time zone.

title: Center a Div with Flexbox
description: Use a flex container to place a card neatly in the middle of the page.
commonMistake: Setting justify-content without display: flex will not affect the child alignment at all.

title: Build a Search Form
description: Create an input and submit button pattern that gives users a clear place to search.
code:
<form class="search">
  <label for="query">Search</label>
  <input id="query" type="search" />
  <button type="submit">Go</button>
</form>
commonMistake: Leaving the button without a type can submit the form unexpectedly in some browsers.

title: Style a Callout Card
description: Give a note block a readable appearance with a soft background and strong border contrast.
commonMistake: Relying on color alone makes the message hard to read for users with low vision.

title: Create a Responsive Card Grid
description: Use media queries to reshape a card grid for smaller screens without losing the content structure.
commonMistake: Setting rigid widths on each column can force overflow on tablets or narrow phones.

title: Build a Navigation Bar
description: Create a semantic navigation menu with a clear active link and accessible labels for the main site sections.
commonMistake: Forgetting the semantic nav landmark or accessible labels makes the menu harder for screen readers to announce clearly.

title: Create a Button Group
description: Group related actions together in one HTML pattern so users can spot the controls as a single set.
commonMistake: Using separate buttons without a shared wrapper makes the actions feel disconnected and harder to scan.

title: Add Large Heading Styles
description: Set a clear visual hierarchy so the page title stands out and remains readable on mobile screens.
commonMistake: Using a fixed pixel size for headings can make the text too large on small devices.

title: Collapse a Mobile Menu
description: Hide the menu on smaller screens and reveal it only when the user chooses the toggle.
code:
Home Topics Search
@media (max-width: 700px) { .nav { display: none; } /* A toggle handler must also reveal the menu. */ .menu-toggle { display: inline-block; } }
commonMistake: Hiding the navigation without a clear toggle or focus path leaves smaller-screen users unable to reach the menu.

title: Create a Validation Message
description: Show a field error with a clear visual style so the user knows what to fix next.
commonMistake: Using only a red border without text makes the message hard to understand for assistive technology.

title: Add Hover States for Links
description: Use a simple state change to make links more obvious without changing the page structure.
code: Course notes Practice quiz
commonMistake: Only styling the default link state leaves keyboard and hover users without a clear visual cue when they interact.

title: Range-based For Loop
description: Iterate over a list of values with a modern loop while keeping the code short and readable.
commonMistake: Forgetting the reference sign means the loop variable is a copy, so updates do not change the original vector element.

title: Reverse a Vector
description: Invert the order of a vector so the first element becomes the last and vice versa.
commonMistake: Calling reverse without including the <algorithm> header will fail at compile time.

title: Pass by Reference
description: Update a value in a function without copying the whole object into a new variable.
commonMistake: Using pass-by-value makes the update invisible outside the function scope.

title: Own an Object with std::unique_ptr
description: Take ownership of a heap object so it is cleaned up automatically when it goes out of scope.
commonMistake: Releasing or copying the same raw pointer twice can leave the object dangling and unpredictable.

title: Sum Array Values
description: Walk through a fixed array and calculate the total of every number in it.
commonMistake: Using the wrong loop bound can read past the end of the array and corrupt memory.

title: Resize a Dynamic Vector
description: Increase the capacity of a vector when more elements need to be added to the collection.
commonMistake: Calling reserve() changes capacity but not size, so indexing before you resize or push values can still leave you out of bounds.

title: Sort Names Alphabetically
description: Order a collection of names with a standard sort and keep the comparison logic straightforward.
commonMistake: Forgetting #include <algorithm> means std::sort is not declared and the program will fail to compile.

title: Handle a Null Pointer
description: Check whether a pointer is empty before reading or writing to the target memory.
commonMistake: Using score without checking means a dangling or null pointer can crash the application.

title: Read a File Line by Line
description: Open a text file and process each line individually to avoid loading the whole file at once.
commonMistake: Ignoring the file-open check can leave the stream in a bad state and make the loop skip all data.

title: Use a Default Argument
description: Give a function parameter a default value so callers can omit it when they want the standard behavior.
commonMistake: Placing a default argument in the middle of a parameter list can make the function call ambiguous.
